Question:

Proletariat has a clone next to Champion Bot and Visionary.

Proletariat has a clone far from them but by an enemy target.

He attacks that target.  Does he get the +2 dice from Champion Bot and the dice swap from Visionary?   Part of me says "yes" because all Proletariats are the same Proletariat, but part of me says that is a really mean combo.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Champion Bot iwould work like that with Proletariat.

All Proletariats are Proletariat, and if Proletariat gains that boost then all Proletariat gain that boost.

Champion Bot gives Proletariat 2 extra attack dice to all Proletariat's attacks, any Proletariat making an attack will benefit.

This works because the bonus is granted to the character, not to the attack or the target making the attack.

 

On the other hand:  What if Foresight is on Visionary, and she has line of sight on a Proletariat, and a Proletariat she can't see makes an attack?

Both are still Proletariat, but they are not the same target, because while they are the same character and share the same health pool, they can be hit seperately by the same AoE attack.  Unlike Omnitron, whose hexes are all one target.

If Proletariat hits his To be continued phase with 2 of his proletariats adjacent to Ra's Tornado Proletariat will face two hazard attacks.

So Foresight would require the Proletariat target making the dice roll to be in line of sight, because it specifies target, not character.

 

I would think Twist the Ether and Wrest the Mind, since they specifies Character not target, would work like Champion Bot.

 

An even rougher question is the term allies and Proletariat.

Abilities that affect allies should affect allied Targets, otherwise Stealth Bot and Proletariat would be ridiculous and non-sensical.  (since one Porletariat gaining cover would cause all Proletariat to gain cover.

But that means motivational charge and Inspiring Presence + Proletariat is awesome.  Which I think Presence is already confirmed to be sick with Proletariat.

(sick meaning you get the effect for each proletariat target in line of sight, so up to 6 +1 attack tokens from presence, and up to 4 hp regained from charge)

Okay, if I was correct above, then Expert Tactician would give Proletariat as many defense +1 tokens as there are proletariats in play, line of sight or not.

That's powerful, but not broken like Stealth Bot, Foresight, Sub-Zero Atmosphere etc. would be if they targeted characters.

 

Bolstering team-up gives an adjacent ally an action, so if a Proletariat was the targetted ally that specific target would have to use the power, doesn't stop that power from being Overwhelm or a sprint that triggers Phalanx, but you couldn't have a non-adjacent proletariat just use duplicate for the Team-Up Power.

Was wrong several times on this thread.

Ronway is correct, I found the ruling on that, Proletariat is one ally.

That won't affect Sub-Zero Atmosphere, because that affects the spaces, not the ally.

However, Stealth Bot grants cover to allies adjacent to Stealth Bot, not to the spaces around it.

Proletariat is one ally, so it seems like Stealth Bot adjacent to Proletariat would grant all of Proletariat cover.

The strength of Stealth+Champion+Proletariat is pretty sick.

Also Foresight would only need to have one proletariat in Visionary's line of sight to affect any of his rolls, and Bolstering team-up will allow any proletariat to use the granted power.

posts.name: Donner
posts.cooked:
Does this change how Visionary works with him?  If he is one ally, does Foresight get to swap dice with him if one of his far-off clones makes a roll?  The ally, after all, is Proletariat, and is in sight.  Just that the part of Proletariat doing the work is not.

So I guess the question is:  When one Proletariat makes a roll, is it Proletariat making the roll or Proletariat's clone making the roll?  If it is Proletariat, then Foresight works on him as long as one clone is in LOS.  If it is the clone, then we get into crazy action shenanigan questions which probably boil down to "it is Proletariat making the roll".

At least, that is my perspective.
